                                                                1415

 1   Carlucci to explain his vote.

 2                SENATOR CARLUCCI:   Thank you, 

 3   Mr. President.  

 4                I want to thank my colleagues for 

 5   supporting this legislation.  

 6                Unfortunately, in New York State 

 7   some of our communities have the distinction of 

 8   paying some of the highest property taxes in the 

 9   nation.  And what this legislation does is really 

10   starts to move our laws into the 21st century.

11                Unfortunately, right now we have an 

12   old law on the books that allows municipalities, 

13   allows towns to charge up to a 1 percent fee to 

14   the school districts on taxes collected.  Many of 

15   the districts, the overwhelming majority of towns 

16   throughout New York, don't charge anything.  But 

17   unfortunately, right in Rockland County I've got 

18   three districts that are charged that full 

19   percent.  And we're talking about millions of 

20   dollars of property tax money that hardworking 

21   people believe is going to the school district, 

22   but instead it's going to the town simply for 

23   collecting a check.

24                We need to modernize our laws.  

25   That's what this legislation does, allows the 


                                                                1416

 1   school districts to negotiate with the towns to 

 2   get a lower fee and maybe -- if they can, if they 

 3   want to -- to collect the taxes themselves.

 4                This is a major savings for some 

 5   school districts in our state.  This is an 

 6   important time to pass this legislation, move our 

 7   laws into the 21st century, make sure that every 

 8   tax that we're putting out there is being put to 

 9   good use.  And particularly in this case, where 

10   we believe it's going to schoolchildren, we 

11   should make sure that that's happening.

12                So I want to thank my colleagues for 

13   supporting this legislation.  This is a step in 

14   the right direction to make sure that we 

15   scrutinize the laws on the books to make sure 

16   we're benefiting taxpayers.

17                Thank you, Mr. President.

 1                Yes, it was too quick.  I voted for 

 2   it in Rules, and I got delayed coming out here 

 3   from Rules.

 4                What's passed today is a donor 

 5   breast milk bill to allow premature babies under 

 6   1500 grams to get, under Medicaid, donor breast 

 7   milk.  

 8                It's a program that obviously 

 9   informally has been going on for centuries; 

10   formally, through the New York Milk Bank, for the 

11   last several years in New York City.  As a matter 

12   of fact, it's even upstate in Crouse, in 

13   Syracuse.  

14                And so we feel that for a minimal 

15   amount of money, about $3300 per premature baby, 

16   we could -- over a period of about 10, 12 weeks, 

17   we could save enormous amounts of money for their 

18   health from the state but, more importantly, save 

19   their health as they go along and grow.  

20                So we've been obviously passing 

21   this.  We passed it last year, both houses.  The 

22   Governor vetoed it, said that it was open-ended, 

23   so we put some restrictions on.  And he said do 

24   it in the budget.  We're trying to do it in the 

25   budget.  So today we're passing it so we can 


                                                                1419

 1   really formally put them on notice we want to see 

 2   it in the budget, and we hope to do it this week.
